responsibility: Internal C++ front-end header for coroutine lowering state and transformation bookkeeping. It defines the per-parameter, per-suspend-point, and per-local-variable records used while analyzing a coroutine body and constructing the coroutine frame, including cached frame field identifiers, proxy variables, destructor/guard information, awaitable storage, and scope-tracking stacks. It also declares the cp_coroutine_transform class that owns one function’s coroutine rewrite state—original body, synthesized frame and helper-function types, resume index, final-suspend label, collected suspend/local/parameter maps, and entry points that validate the function and drive the body-to-ramp/actor/destroyer transformation implemented in coroutines.cc.
same_name_distinction: Declares the coroutine front-end data structures and the cp_coroutine_transform interface used by the rest of gcc/cp, whereas the same-stem implementation file gcc/cp/coroutines.cc performs the actual validation, AST rewriting, and synthesis of ramp/resumer/destroyer functions.
